MarginPad API

Everything the site knows, as JSON: live prices and candles, a scored screener, funding, open interest, long/short, liquidations measured from nine exchanges, an economic calendar — keyless. Plus a full paper-trading Bot API to forward-test a trading bot on real prices with no real money, a remote MCP server so an AI assistant can use all of it natively, an OpenAPI 3.1 spec and one-file Python and JavaScript clients.

Market data — /api/v1/*, keyless

Every response is the envelope { ok, data, ts } ({ ok:false, error:{ code, message } } on failure) with CORS on, so a browser page can call it directly. 60 requests a minute per IP without a key. Send a free X-API-Key (from /trading-api/) on the same calls and they are metered against your key instead — 120 a minute, 600 on Premium. Full manual with examples: /free-crypto-api/.

EndpointWhat you get

GET/api/v1/pricesBatch snapshot of the top coins in one call.

GET/api/v1/symbols~500 liquid USDT-perp symbols by volume.

Paper-trading Bot API — /api/bot/v1/* and /api/bot/v2/*

Point a trading bot at real live prices and settle every trade in simulated dollars: isolated margin, leverage up to 1000×, liquidations confirmed on 1-minute candles, taker fees and funding charged like an exchange. Sign in with an email and mint a key on /trading-api/; positions live on your account and count for the season boards. v1 response shapes are frozen; v2 is the same API in the { ok, data, ts } envelope. Auth: X-API-Key.

EndpointWhat it does
GET/api/bot/v1/price · /klines · /time · /marketsFill price, candles, server clock (with drift_ms) and every tradable symbol with its leverage cap and fee — the first three need no key.
POST/api/bot/v1/openMarket open at the live price with optional sl, tp, trail_pct 2.3, client_order_id (idempotent retries) and dry_run 2.3 (price it, write nothing).
POST/api/bot/v1/open type: limit | stopResting orders that fill AT your level from 1m candles while the bot is offline: a limit below the market or a stop entry above it 2.3.
GET/api/bot/v1/ordersResting orders (with type) plus the last 20 that filled, expired or were cancelled.
POST/api/bot/v1/modify_orderChange a resting order in place: price, sl, tp, margin, leverage, trailing stop 2.3.
POST/api/bot/v1/cancel_orderCancel a resting order (a filled one answers 409, so a retry can never undo a fill).
POST/api/bot/v1/close · /close_allClose one position, partially with pct, or everything; P&L settles net of the round-trip fee and funding.
POST/api/bot/v1/sltpMove the stop-loss, take-profit or trailing stop on an open position without closing it.
GET/api/bot/v1/positions?status=openPositions with live mark price and P&L; ETag / 304 when nothing changed; ?since=.
GET/api/bot/v1/trades · /account · /balance · /usagePaged closed-trade ledger, lifetime account stats, balance and equity, your plan with limits and entitlements.
GET/api/bot/v1/feesCharge your paper fills at a real venue’s taker schedule less our referral discount (Bybit, Binance, OKX, Bitget, MEXC, Gate, KuCoin, Kraken, Hyperliquid); POST sets the account default, fee_venue on open overrides it 2.4.
GET/api/bot/v1/report?days=30Your 30-day trading report: totals and skill score free; by coin / leverage / side / hour / day and written findings on Premium 2.3.
WSwss://marginpad.io/api/bot/v2/stream?api_key=…Position opened / updated / closed events and mark prices pushed every ~2 s. Free on every plan.
GET/api/bot/v1/webhooks PremiumTrading events POSTed to your own URL, HMAC-SHA256 signed and retried, whether or not the bot is connected 2.3.
POST/api/bot/v1/ai PremiumThe chart panel’s AI read from the API: an answer, a parsed plan and the brief it reasoned over, 50 a day 2.3.

MCP — use it from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor

Add https://marginpad.io/mcp as a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP). Market-data tools need no key; set the header X-API-Key for the paper-trading tools. 23 tools: get_price, get_klines, get_markets, get_screener, get_funding, get_open_interest, get_liquidations, get_fear_greed, get_economic_calendar, calc_liquidation, calc_position_size, paper_balance, paper_positions, paper_trades, paper_open, paper_close, paper_sltp, paper_modify_order, paper_fees, paper_report, paper_limit_order, paper_orders, paper_cancel_order.

Clients — one file, zero dependencies

marginpad.py (Python 3.8+, urllib only; websockets optional for the stream) and marginpad.js (Node 18+ or a browser). Both cover market data, every paper-trading call, ETag polling, 429 back-off, the WebSocket stream and webhook signature verification.

from marginpad import MarginPad
mp = MarginPad("mpb_...")                              # key from /trading-api/
print(mp.price("BTC"))                                 # keyless market data
r = mp.open("BTC", "long", margin_usd=100, leverage=10, trail_pct=1.5,
            client_order_id="sig-1403")                # a retry can never open twice
print(r["position"]["liq_price"], mp.report()["skill"])

Calculators — /api/*, plain JSON

A free, public JSON API for the most common crypto futures calculations. No API key, no signup, CORS-enabled — call it from anywhere.

Base URL   https://marginpad.io/api
Method     GET
Auth       none
CORS       enabled (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *)
Format     JSON   (also under /api/v1/calc/* in the { ok, data, ts } envelope)

Liquidation price

GET /api/liquidation?entry=60000&leverage=10&side=long&mmr=0.5
entryrequired — entry price
leveragerequired — leverage multiple (>0)
sideoptional — long (default) or short
mmroptional — maintenance margin rate %, default 0.5
{
  "side": "long",
  "liquidationPrice": 54300,
  "distancePct": -9.5
}

Position size (by risk)

GET /api/position-size?balance=5000&risk=1&entry=60000&stop=58800&leverage=10
balancerequired — account balance
riskrequired — risk per trade %
entryrequired — entry price
stoprequired — stop-loss price
leverageoptional — for margin required
{ "positionSize": 0.041667, "notional": 2500, "riskAmount": 50, "marginRequired": 250 }

PnL / ROI / ROE

GET /api/pnl?entry=60000&exit=66000&size=0.5&leverage=10&side=long
{ "pnl": 3000, "roiPct": 10, "roePct": 100 }

Risk / reward

GET /api/risk-reward?entry=60000&stop=58000&tp=66000
{ "riskRewardRatio": 3, "riskPerUnit": 2000, "rewardPerUnit": 6000, "breakevenWinRatePct": 25 }

Take-profit target

GET /api/take-profit?entry=60000&leverage=10&roe=75&side=long
{ "targetExitPrice": 64500, "priceMovePct": 7.5 }

Notes

Calculations use the isolated-margin estimate and are for educational use, not financial advice. Figures exclude exchange fees and funding. The API is provided free and as-is. If you build something with it, a link back to marginpad.io is appreciated. Market data is free for public use, attribution appreciated; the Bot API is a simulator and never touches real funds. Educational only, not financial advice.
